{#- Mercury Shipping & Packing Label — ONE LABEL PER PHYSICAL UNIT (per serial no). Page 1 = shipment manifest, then one full label page per component unit. -#} {%- set ns = namespace(all=[]) -%} {%- for item in doc.items -%} {%- set raw = (item.serial_no or (get_serial_or_batch_nos(item.serial_and_batch_bundle) if item.serial_and_batch_bundle else "")) | replace(",", "\n") -%} {%- set snos = raw.split("\n") | map("trim") | reject("equalto", "") | list -%} {%- if snos -%} {%- for sr in snos -%} {%- set _ = ns.all.append({"item": item, "sr": sr, "n": loop.index, "of": snos|length}) -%} {%- endfor -%} {%- else -%} {#- non-serialised line: one label for the whole lot -#} {%- set _ = ns.all.append({"item": item, "sr": None, "n": 1, "of": 1}) -%} {%- endif -%} {%- endfor -%} {%- set total = ns.all | length -%} {%- set logo = "/assets/mercury/images/mercury_logo.png" -%} {#- single source of truth for logo size — used identically on the manifest and every label -#} {%- set logo_w = 106 -%}
{#- Frappe's print style forces `.print-format td img { width:100% !important }` (legacy mozilla table hack), which overrides any inline width on the image. Wrapping in a fixed-width box makes that 100% resolve to logo_w, so the preview and the generated PDF render identically. -#}
